Adolion: Between the Roads
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
Homecoming
At the Guild hall in Aegis City.
The Guildmaster has just put your party up for the C-rank promotion exam in front of the whole hall. Sign, ask for time or say no: the choice is yours.
What happens next is yours to decide.
About this story
A week in Aegis City between adventures. The Adventurer's Guild has started to notice your party, and the C-rank promotion exam is coming due: before it there are errands to run, gear to buy, favours to carry across the city and long nights in its taverns. Expect warm, busy slice-of-life days with rivals and odd neighbours, and a real test at the end of the week. Bring the adventurer you have been so far, travelling with Belle and Dalan.
Open threads
The party must complete the C-rank exam interview and then survive a week of preparation for a Guild-chosen C-rank quest judged by Vallie's appointed observer.
The party must sign the completed C-rank exam forms Ellie has prepared before the sign-up is finalized.
Following along.
